lead: N. T. Rama Rao was an Indian actor, born on 28 May 1923 in Nemmikuru.
He died on 18 January 1996 in Hyderabad at the age of 72.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh and Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh.
This profile collects the N. facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: N. T. Rama Rao — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: N. T. Rama Rao was born on 28 May 1923 in Nemmikuru, and holds citizenship of India and Dominion of India.
Public records name his father, Nandamuri Lakshmaiah and his mother, Nandamuri Venkata ramamma.
He received his education at Andhra-Christian College and Andhra University.
He is recorded as speaking Telugu, English and Tamil.

sections.heading: N. T. Rama Rao — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician, film director, film producer, film actor and writer as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh (1983–1984), Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh (1984–1989), Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh (1994–1995) and member of a Legislative Assembly of India (1983–1996). He is affiliated with Telugu Desam Party.

sections.heading: N. T. Rama Rao — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He has been married to Lakshmi Parvathi (married 1993, until 1996), Basava Tarakam (married 1942, until 1985) and Basava Tarakam.
He is a parent to Nandamuri Harikrishna, Daggubati Purandeswari, Nandamuri Balakrishna and Nara Bhuvaneshwari.
